methodology: Static inventory is derived from runtime registries, UI source definitions and the existing live/contract evidence corpus. A testRefs mapping is required for every item; mapped does not claim executable PyMOL parity.

featureGroups.label: Ball-and-Stick
limitations: Sphere radius is a presentation parameter.

featureGroups.label: Space-Filling
limitations: This is atom-centered space filling, not a molecular surface.

featureGroups.label: Van der Waals Surface
limitations: Surface generation is delegated to 3Dmol; exact PyMOL surface equivalence is unverified.

featureGroups.label: Solvent-Accessible Surface
limitations: This is a render projection; quantitative SASA is not a scientific result.

featureGroups.label: Solvent-Excluded Surface
limitations: This is a render projection; quantitative surface area is not a scientific result.

featureGroups.label: Mesh
limitations: Wireframe material and exact PyMOL mesh conformance are renderer-qualified.

featureGroups.label: Dots
limitations: Dots are deterministic presentation sampling, not a quantitative area result.

featureGroups.label: Dot Surface
limitations: Dot Surface is Mole Explorer native and not an exact PyMOL token.

featureGroups.label: Ribbon
limitations: Exact PyMOL ribbon conformance is unverified; renderer-native oval geometry is explicit and distinct from Cartoon.

featureGroups.label: Putty
limitations: No fabricated B-factor is supplied; exact PyMOL conformance is unverified.

featureGroups.label: Non-bonded (crosses)
limitations: Low or zero eligibility is valid.

featureGroups.label: Non-bonded (spheres)
limitations: Low or zero eligibility is valid.

featureGroups.label: Licorice
limitations: Non-bonded contribution may be sparse by definition.

featureGroups.label: By Formal Charge
featureGroups.missingValuePolicy: unknown remains unknown and emits diagnostic
